title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index (November 2027), 10:00 a.m. ET — month-end, inside the December blackout, six sessions before a SEP decision
source: EST: the publisher's stated rule, re-read this session off conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 332,031 bytes -- byte-identical to the June through October siblings' fetches of the same page) -- "The Conference Board publishes the Consumer Confidence Index (R) at 10 a.m. ET on the last Tuesday of every month." 2027-11-30 is the last Tuesday of November 2027 and a full NYSE session. THE NOVEMBER RULE IS DOUBLE-SOURCED 3 OF 3 IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, ALL SEVEN PUBLISHER FETCHES SERIAL AND EACH VERIFIED AGAINST ITS OWN "Source: <Month> <Year> Consumer Confidence Survey" LINE AND ITS OWN "Updated:" STAMP rather than trusted by slug: CCI-Nov-2022 (888,059 bytes, Updated 2022-11-29), CCI-Nov-2023 (1,041,462 bytes, Updated 2023-11-28), CCI-Nov-2024 (890,772 bytes, Updated 2024-11-26). All three byte counts match the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 sibling's fetches of the same three documents exactly. Each is the last Tuesday of its November; each was announced in advance by its October predecessor's next-release line (recorded by that sibling); and NEW HERE, each is confirmed FORWARD by the December edition it names, all three of which this chain reached for the first time this session -- CCI-Nov-2022 "The next release is Wednesday, December 21" leads to CCI-Dec-2022 (889,114 bytes, Updated 2022-12-21); CCI-Nov-2023 "Wednesday, December 20" leads to CCI-Dec-2023 (1,264,748 bytes, Updated 2023-12-20); CCI-Nov-2024 "Monday, December 23rd" leads to CCI-Dec-2024 (898,445 bytes, Updated 2024-12-23). NOTE WHAT THOSE THREE FORWARD LINES SAY, because it is the finding this entry exists for: NONE of them names a last Tuesday. December is the one month the publisher's own rule does not govern, which this calendar already knew from the December editions themselves (the consumer-confidence-2026-12-22 lane) -- what is new is that the NOVEMBER edition announces the break three to four weeks ahead, 3 of 3, which makes this print the earliest primary observation of December's date each year. INDEPENDENTLY DATED BY A SECOND PUBLISHER, re-fetched rather than inherited: fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-06) posts a "2027 HPI Release Dates" table whose eleventh row reads "Tuesday, November 30 | Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables) | September 2027 and 2027Q3" -- one of twelve 2027 rows, all twelve matching this chain's rule-derived last Tuesdays. That corroborates the calendar arithmetic, never the Conference Board's intentions. Filed estimate because no November-2027 announcement exists: this is the publisher's own rule applied forward against a now-fully-double-sourced November record. Promote on the October 2027 edition's next-release line naming 2027-11-30. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the consumer-confidence-2027-11-30 initial-research lane (2026-09-06) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/consumer-confidence-2027-11-30.from-consumer-confidence-2027-10-26.json, which is now inert. Its four cautions were re-tested rather than inherited: two hold, one is MIXED and one is INCOMPLETE in a way that matters. WHAT THE RESEARCH FOUND. (1) THE NOVEMBER EDITION IS THE CHAIN'S FORWARD-ANNOUNCEMENT VENUE FOR DECEMBER'S RULE-BREAK, 3 OF 3. December has never published on its rule-derived last Tuesday: 2021-12-22, 2022-12-21, 2023-12-20, 2024-12-23 and 2025-12-23 sit 6, 6, 6, 8 and 7 days early on three different weekdays. This calendar already held that from the December editions (the consumer-confidence-2026-12-22 and -12-29 pair), and this session independently reproduces three of those five dates from the December editions' own Updated stamps. NEW: the NOVEMBER edition names the date first, every year, so a December CB estimate has a dated promotion trigger about four weeks ahead rather than none. (2) A PUBLISHER WEEKDAY-LABEL ERROR WAS FOUND AND CLOSED, and it is a live caution because this chain's whole date method reads these lines. CCI-Dec-2022's next-release line reads "Wednesday, January 31"; 2023-01-31 was a TUESDAY, and CCI-Jan-2023's own stamp is 2023-01-31. The date was right and the weekday label wrong -- 1 error in the 7 forward lines read this session. Trust the date, never the weekday. (3) DECEMBER RESTATES NOVEMBER +1.2 / -1.0 / +1.1, AND THE MAGNITUDE IS THE TIGHTEST IN THE CHAIN WHILE THE SIGN IS A COIN FLIP. November first prints 100.2 / 102.0 / 111.7 are restated to 101.4, 101.0 ("downwardly revised") and 112.8 (derived from CCI-Dec-2024's stated -8.1 to 104.7): 2 of 3 up, mean +0.43, but the absolute revision is 1.2 / 1.0 / 1.1 -- a spread of 0.2 against 2.6, 2.2, 1.1 and 3.2 for the four months the chain already had. November's first print is reliably about 1.1 points wrong and unreliably in which direction, the exact inverse of October's large-and-reliably-downward. The five-month sequence now reads: Aug-restates-Jul -0.60, Sep-restates-Aug +1.77, Oct-restates-Sep +0.53, Nov-restates-Oct -0.97, Dec-restates-Nov +0.43. (4) THE 80-THRESHOLD BAND IS SCORED OUT OF SAMPLE A SECOND TIME AND ITS ACTIONABLE HALF IS NOW 0 OF 10. Three new pairs, all outside the band: Nov 2022 Expectations 75.4 restated 76.7 (distance 4.6), Nov 2023 77.8 restated 77.4 (2.2), Nov 2024 92.3 restated 93.7 (12.3) -- none flipped side. Pooled sixteen pairs: outside 2.0 points of 80.0, 0 of 10 (was 0 of 7); inside, unchanged at 3 of 6. Eleven up / five down overall. (5) THE PROPOSAL'S CUT-OFF PROJECTION IS NARROWED AND MOVED EARLIER, BY CHANGING THE ANCHOR. November's stated cut-offs are November 18, November 15 and November 18, 2024 -- lags of 11 / 13 / 8 (the proposal's figures, SUPPORTED to the day, and the longest and widest in the chain). But the DAY OF MONTH spans only 15-18, a 3-day spread against the lag's 5, so November's cut-off should be projected from the day of month, not from the release date: 2027-11-15 to 2027-11-18, against the proposal's 11-17 to 11-22. October is the opposite (lags 6/7/6 spread 1, days 19/24/23 spread 5), so the anchor is month-specific and a neighbour's method must not be borrowed any more than a neighbour's numbers. (6) TWO NEW CHANNELS WERE BUILT AND BOTH ARE NULL. Month-end: 11 of the 68 CB days are their month's last trading session and 2027-11-30 is one of them, but month-end CB days against other CB days is 1 of 9 (TLT 0.0374) and ALL month-end sessions against the rest of the tape is 0 of 9 -- there is no month-end effect here to inherit, so the single crossing is the expected false positive. SEP proximity: CB days within 15 sessions of a SEP decision, n=14 vs 54, 0 of 9. (7) NOVEMBER HOLDS BOTH ARMS OF THE THANKSGIVING QUESTION AND THE SPLIT IS DETERMINISTIC. 2021-11-30, 2022-11-29 and 2023-11-28 fall after Thanksgiving; 2024-11-26, 2025-11-25 and 2026-11-24 fall before it. The print precedes Thanksgiving exactly when November 1 is a Friday, Saturday or Sunday. 2027 is an AFTER year, five days past. Within-November after-vs-before is 0 of 9 at n=3 vs 2. (8) AND THE ONE APPARENT SIGNAL IN THIS WHOLE STUDY WAS A HALF-SESSION ARTIFACT. Post-Thanksgiving-week sessions against the rest of the tape are 4 of 9 -- SPY 0.642 vs 0.973 (p=0.0045) and XLY 1.053 vs 1.442 (p=0.0016) both clearing even a Bonferroni 0.00556 -- which would have been the chain's first multi-instrument crossing. Removing the five Black Fridays collapses it to 1 of 9; the five Black Fridays ALONE are 5 of 9. The compression is the 1:00 p.m. ET half session, not the week. 2027-11-30 is a full Tuesday session three sessions past Black Friday, so none of it reaches this print. (9) THE PROPOSAL'S "QUIET CELL" CAUTION IS MIXED, AND IT PARTLY REHABILITATES A RULE THE 10-26 SIBLING TOLD THE CHAIN TO RETIRE. November's VIX median is 17.25 against October's 19.33 (p=0.0001), so October's widening is given back exactly as the proposal said. But November against the rest of the year is 3 of 9 and MIXED IN SIGN: XLF narrower (p=0.0030), AAPL narrower (0.0405), TLT WIDER (0.0184) -- and it survives excluding the post-Thanksgiving week (XLF 0.0097, TLT 0.0158, AMZN 0.0368). Quiet in VIX level and in financials, wider in rates. So retire the SEASONAL generalisation of the 08-31 cell rule, as the 10-26 sibling argued, but keep the monthly cell read: Aug narrow, Sep wider, Oct widest, Nov back down is a real and non-monotone shape. (10) THE PROPOSAL'S "CLEAN PRINT" IS RIGHT ABOUT COLLISION AND INCOMPLETE ABOUT THE FED. The 2027 FOMC panel has no November meeting at all (Oct 26-27, then Dec 7-8 with a SEP), so this is genuinely collision-free. But the Board's own ten-days-earlier rule puts the December blackout at 2027-11-27 to 2027-12-09, so the print sits FOUR DAYS INSIDE one -- the third tracked print to do so -- and it is about six trading sessions ahead of the 2027-12-08 SEP decision, CLOSER THAN ANY OF THE 68 CB DAYS IN THE RECORD (minimum gap 10 sessions; the five November prints run 10 to 15). The blackout channel is already measured null and this session replicated it character-for-character (23 vs 45, 0 of 9, SPY 0.921/0.788 p=0.8764; clean-in-window 6 vs 45, 0 of 9), but the SEP-approach distance is outside the record's range, so that null does not cover this configuration and the limit is stated rather than papered over. (11) DIRECTIONAL: EIGHTH MONTH, EIGHTH REFUSAL, AND NOT CLOSE. November CB days are 3 of 5 up, SPY close-to-close median +0.099% against +0.325% on other late-November sessions, p=0.5957 -- the CB median is BELOW its comparator, unlike October's 5 of 5. The twelve-month scan reproduces the 09-28 and 10-26 siblings character-for-character (April 0.0150, September 0.3796, October 0.1643, November 0.5957). (12) METHOD: the whole nine-instrument pipeline replicates the April through October siblings EXACTLY, 9 of 9 to three decimals on n=1,447 sessions and 68 CB days splitting 51 clean / 17 colliding (17 day-ones, 0 decision days), and the FOMC parser's three banked assertions all held (56 meetings, 8 in every year 2021-2027, 28 SEP). No captcha across 7 serial publisher fetches; probe-ref.blocked is empty. Three monthly VIX medians differ from the 10-26 sibling's in the second decimal (Jun 16.70 vs 16.73, Sep 17.20 vs 17.17, Nov 17.25 vs 17.21) while the other nine match exactly -- recorded rather than smoothed; no comparison in either ledger turns on it. SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS EVERY CB ENTRY: symbols is empty and no house playbook is macro- or sentiment-keyed. Corridor: ZERO tracked events existed anywhere in November or December 2027 when this research began. TWO are proposed with it -- consumer-confidence-2027-12-22 and fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 -- and TWO MORE WERE DELIBERATELY NOT FILED because sibling lanes proposed the same ids the same day with equal or better sourcing: fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 (from-fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26, which cites a second FHFA primary this session did not read) and fomc-2027-12-08 (from-fomc-2027-10-26). A duplicate file would have been calendar noise, so what this lane found about those two events lives in its ledger instead. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
